# Seoul Entertainment Trip Snapshot

A 4-day, entertainment-first Seoul plan for 2 adults from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13**, built around concerts, K-pop spots, live music, and one cultural stop per day. I’m assuming **moderate walking**, **subway/taxi mix**, and **mid-range dining** to keep the **non-flight total under USD 900**.

# Day-by-Day Seoul Itinerary and Budget

## Day 1: Hongdae live music + indie night
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note-beamed.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, easy lunch near Hongdae; keep the pace light after travel.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **KT&G Sangsangmadang** for a creative/cultural stop and nearby street art.
- **Evening:** Catch a **live music set in Hongdae**; this area is best for small venues and spontaneous performances.
- **Backup indoor activity:** Hongdae shopping arcades and a café-hopping loop if rain changes the plan.
- **Transit tip:** Use the **Airport Railroad + Line 2** or a taxi from your hotel after the show; Hongdae is one of the easiest nightlife areas to navigate without long walks.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **USD 150–190**
  - Food/drinks: 50–70
  - Cultural stop: 0–20
  - Live music cover/entry: 20–40
  - Transit: 10–20
  - Misc. buffer: 30–40

## Day 2: K-pop landmarks + concert night in Jamsil
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- **Morning:** Start with **COEX / Starfield Library** for a polished Seoul city stop with strong K-pop-adjacent energy.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **SMTOWN Coex Artium area** if open/available for your dates, then relax with a late lunch nearby.
- **Evening:** Plan for a **concert or large live event** around **Jamsil / Olympic Park / KSPO Dome** if a show is scheduled.
- **Backup indoor activity:** COEX Mall movie theater, aquarium, or extended mall browsing if the concert timing shifts.
- **Transit tip:** For Jamsil-area events, the **subway is usually better than taxis after peak hours**; arrive early to avoid crowding.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **USD 260–360**
  - Food/drinks: 50–70
  - Cultural stop: 0–15
  - Concert tickets: 140–240
  - Transit: 10–20
  - Misc. buffer: 30–35

## Day 3: Myeongdong / Namsan culture + jazz or lounge music
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **National Museum of Korean Contemporary History** or another central museum stop for a lighter cultural day.
- **Afternoon:** Explore **Myeongdong** for shopping, snacks, and an easy indoor walking zone.
- **Evening:** Book a **jazz bar, acoustic venue, or lounge performance** in central Seoul for a more relaxed music night.
- **Backup indoor activity:** Department-store rooftop lounges, galleries, or a longer café session if rain is heavy.
- **Transit tip:** Central Seoul works well with **subway Line 4 + short taxi hops**; keep evening venues close to your hotel to reduce late-night transfers.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **USD 130–180**
  - Food/drinks: 50–70
  - Museum/cultural stop: 0–20
  - Venue cover/drinks: 20–50
  - Transit: 10–15
  - Misc. buffer: 20–25

## Day 4: K-pop district stop + final showcase night
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Head to **Gangnam** for a polished K-pop-themed district walk and photo stop near entertainment agency zones.
- **Afternoon:** Add a cultural stop such as **National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Seoul branch** or a nearby gallery.
- **Evening:** Use your last night for a **final live performance, showcase, or fan-event-style venue** depending on what is scheduled.
- **Backup indoor activity:** Gangnam underground mall browsing and café lounges if the weather turns wet.
- **Transit tip:** Gangnam is easy by **subway**, but a **taxi after dinner** is often worth it if you’re carrying shopping bags or leaving late.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **USD 150–190**
  - Food/drinks: 50–70
  - Cultural stop: 0–20
  - Live event/cover: 20–50
  - Transit: 10–20
  - Misc. buffer: 30–40

# Budget Check and Best-Fit Plan

| Day | Main Focus | Estimated Cost for 2 | Rain Backup | Transit Style |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Day 1 | Hongdae live music | USD 150–190 | Indoor cafés + shopping arcades | Subway + short taxi |
| Day 2 | K-pop spots + concert | USD 260–360 | COEX Mall / aquarium / cinema | Subway first |
| Day 3 | Museum + jazz night | USD 130–180 | Galleries + department stores | Subway + short taxi |
| Day 4 | Gangnam K-pop district | USD 150–190 | Underground mall + café lounges | Subway + taxi late |

- **Projected total:** **USD 690–920**
- To stay safely under **USD 900**, use these controls:
  - Keep **Day 2 concert tickets** in the lower-mid range
  - Choose **1 paid museum max** if the others are free
  - Limit taxis to **late-night or rain-only** segments
  - Use **1 drink minimum** at live venues instead of multiple rounds
